Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly as described in the points below.

Goal
* Please format "-1" as a {{constant}}.

Input
* Please remove all the constraints; they belong to the Constraints section and need not be repeated here.

* Please format "Line 1" and "Line 2" in <<bold>>.

* Please format "N", "a1", "a2" and "aN" as [[variables]].

Output
* Please format "-1" as a {{constant}}.

Constraints
* Please format "N" and "ai" as [[variables]].

* Please change 100 to 10 because [[N]] never exceeds 10 in the cases.

* Please change 10^9 to 1000. The allowable range should be chosen more proportionally; having a single case with inputs around (10^9) does not sufficiently justify setting the upper bound that high.

Cases
Validator 2: As mentioned earlier, please reduce the inputs to 1000 or below. The large inputs and the output of -1 in this case also make the validator inconsistent with Test 2, which uses small inputs and produces an output other than -1.

* Each test and its validator should cover the same scenario but with slightly different inputs (and outputs where applicable). Please revise the cases so that each pair has a clearly defined objective. For example:

  - Test 1 and Validator 1: Simple example with small values to illustrate the task, output ≠ -1

  - Test 2 and Validator 2: Single-digit inputs, output ≠ -1

  - Test 3 and Validator 3: Mix of single-digit and multi-digit inputs, output = -1

  - Test 4 and Validator 4: Larger values, output ≠ -1

  - Test 5 and Validator 5: Mix of single-digit and multi-digit inputs, output ≠ -1

* When designing the cases, please ensure that random numbers are used and they should cover the range from 1 to 1000 in a balanced manner.

* The input lists should be unsorted.

* Also make sure that each digit from 0 to 9 appears at least once across the tests overall.

* Similarly and separately, make sure that each digit from 0 to 9 appears at least once across the validators overall.

Title
* Consider renaming the contribution from "Digit Sum Clash" to "Even Digit Sum".

Thanks.
